summary:
The most notable new issue affects split_file_to_collection, where 20 tests failed with a history not found error, alongside a single new output mismatch in deeptools_plot_enrichment. The history error text likely reflects a session state or history lifecycle failure where the execution workspace was deleted or became inaccessible before the tests completed. Persistent issues—including the long-standing shared input data failure and several recurring tool-specific errors—remain stable compared to recent runs, requiring no action.

The absence of database connection-pool timeouts elsewhere in this run makes a general server-overload explanation unlikely. This points instead toward a localized history handling or workspace management issue specific to that test workflow.
